reason: I'm always hunting for indoor places for a 4-year-old and a baby, and a clean spot with a gated baby area where I can sit with a coffee is exactly what my moms group asks for. The free first visit makes it easy to try, and the weekday morning moms-group rate fits how we meet.
objection: It's a drive for us and gas adds up, so if it isn't worth the trip more than a couple times a month I'll drop off fast. Also $13 plus $7 for the sibling adds up quickly.
